summary.text: Albert Sommers is a Republican former speaker of the Wyoming House of Representatives and a rancher who is the Republican candidate for House District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He represented the district from 2013 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Albert Sommers earned a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from the University of Wyoming in 1981, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as rancher.
Sommers assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 7, 2013, representing District 20, and left office on January 6, 2025.
He served as majority leader from 2021 to January 10, 2023, and as speaker of the House from January 10, 2023 until he left office.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the Management Council Committee and the Joint Rules and Procedure Committee.
He did not seek re-election to the House in 2024; he instead ran for Wyoming State Senate District 14 and lost the Republican primary to Laura Taliaferro Pearson.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary to seek his old House seat.
